```yaml
name: Build Test Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          use-custom-docker-registry: false
          docker-image-name: "opendata-oss/opendata"
          docker-build-dir: "."
          docker-build-script: "docker build -t opendata-oss/opendata:${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.sha }} ."
          docker-build-timeout-minutes: 30
          custom-tag-prefix: ""
          working-directory: "."
          docker-registry: "ghcr.io"
          always-rebuild: true
          push: true
          force-push: true
          repo-name: "opendata-oss/opendata"
          ci-docker-hash: ${{ github.sha }}
```
